name: Create a tunnel route
description: Create a tunnel route Routes a private network through a Cloudflare Tunnel. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/teamnet/routes
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/teamnet/routes
Routes a private network through a Cloudflare Tunnel.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Create a tunnel route (CIDR Endpoint)
description: Create a tunnel route (CIDR Endpoint) Routes a private network through a Cloudflare Tunnel. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/teamnet/routes/network/{ip_network_encoded}

name: Delete a tunnel route
description: Delete a tunnel route Deletes a private network route from an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/teamnet/routes/{route_id}

name: Delete a tunnel route (CIDR Endpoint)
description: Delete a tunnel route (CIDR Endpoint) Deletes a private network route from an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/teamnet/routes/network/{ip_network_encoded}
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/teamnet/routes/network/{ip_network_encoded}
Deletes a private network route from an account. The CIDR in `ip_network_encoded` must be written in URL-encoded format. If no virtual_network_id is provided it will delete the route from the default vnet. If no tun_type is provided it will fetch the type from the tunnel_id or if that is missing it will assume Cloudflare Tunnel as default. If tunnel_id is provided it will delete the route from that tunnel, otherwise it will delete the route based on the vnet and tun_type.
Required: ip_network_encoded (path); account_id (path)
Optional: virtual_network_id (query); tun_type (query); tunnel_id (query)

name: Get tunnel route
description: Get tunnel route Get a private network route in an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/teamnet/routes/{route_id}

name: Get tunnel route by IP
description: Get tunnel route by IP Fetches routes that contain the given IP address. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/teamnet/routes/ip/{ip}
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/teamnet/routes/ip/{ip}
Fetches routes that contain the given IP address.
Required: ip (path); account_id (path)
Optional: virtual_network_id (query); default_virtual_network_fallback (query) — When the virtual_network_id parameter is not provided the request filter will default search routes that are in the default virtual network for the account. If this parameter is set to false, the search will include routes that do not have a virtual network.

Lists and filters private network routes in an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: comment (query); is_deleted (query); network_subset (query); network_superset (query); existed_at (query); tunnel_id (query); route_id (query); tun_types (query); virtual_network_id (query); per_page (query); page (query)
